lead_independence.lead: Jason Gunter, 45, was arrested by the U.S. Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia, on Tuesday on an outstanding warrant obtained by St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office detectives. lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office deputies executed a search warrant Tuesday as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

lead_independence.lead: The U.S. Marshals Service arrested 45-year-old Jason Gunter at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia, in connection with the death of his 3-month-old son, who died from severe dehydration and malnutrition. Gunter has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County. Gunter has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County. The arrest came after three others were previously charged in the case: the child's mother, 27-year-old Nicole Maxwell, the child's grandfather, Robert Maxwell, and Robert Maxwell's girlfriend, 38-year-old Vikki Koon.

lead_independence.headline: Detectives execute search warrant at Fort Pierce home in $7 million Southern Truss fraud case
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office confirmed that deputies served a search warrant as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.
